description: Family-wide fungal targeting scan plus PTS1 dodecamer context analysis comparing AMD2 with ten yeast peroxisomal PTS1 proteins
code:
import requests, re, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

R = pd.read_csv("fungal_amidase_sw_vs_AMD2.csv")
F = pd.read_csv("fungal_PF01425_raw.csv").set_index("acc")["seq"].to_dict()
AMD2 = "".join(open("amd2_P22580.fasta").read().splitlines()[1:])

kd = dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,
          K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
eis = dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
           L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
STRICT=re.compile(r"[SAC][KRH][LM]$"); PERM=re.compile(r"[SAPCTNKQGV][KRHNQSM][LMIVFYA]$")
PTS2=re.compile(r"[RK][LVIQ]..[LVIHQ][LSGAK].[HQ][LAF]")
def mom(s,deg=100):
    a=np.deg2rad(deg)*np.arange(len(s)); h=np.array([eis[x] for x in s if x in eis])
    if len(h)<len(s): a=a[:len(h)]
    return np.hypot((h*np.cos(a)).sum(),(h*np.sin(a)).sum())/max(len(h),1)

# best homolog per species (top SW hit), plus AMD2 itself
best = R.sort_values("sw_score",ascending=False).groupby("sp",as_index=False).head(1)
rows=[]
for _,r in best.iterrows():
    s=F[r["acc"]]
    h=np.array([kd.get(a,0) for a in s]); k19=np.convolve(h,np.ones(19)/19,mode="valid")
    n30=s[:30]
    rows.append(dict(species=r["sp"], acc=r["acc"], norm_SW=r["norm_score"], length=len(s),
        cterm3=s[-3:], PTS1_strict=bool(STRICT.search(s[-3:])), PTS1_perm=bool(PERM.search(s[-3:])),
        PTS2=bool(PTS2.search(s[:60])),
        nterm30_R=n30.count("R"), nterm30_DE=sum(a in "DE" for a in n30),
        helix_moment=round(mom(s[:18]),3), maxKD19_N40=round(float(k19[:40].max()),2),
        nTM=int((k19>1.6).sum())))
h=np.array([kd.get(a,0) for a in AMD2]); k19=np.convolve(h,np.ones(19)/19,mode="valid")
rows.insert(0, dict(species="Saccharomyces cerevisiae (AMD2)", acc="P22580", norm_SW=1.0, length=549,
    cterm3="SKI", PTS1_strict=False, PTS1_perm=True, PTS2=False,
    nterm30_R=0, nterm30_DE=4, helix_moment=round(mom(AMD2[:18]),3),
    maxKD19_N40=round(float(k19[:40].max()),2), nTM=int((k19>1.6).sum())))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",330)
print("=== targeting-signal scan of AMD2's closest amidase-signature homolog in each fungal lineage ===")
print(D.to_string(index=False))
D.to_csv("fungal_homolog_targeting_scan.csv",index=False)
print(f"\nPTS1 (strict) present in: {D.PTS1_strict.sum()}/{len(D)}")
print(f"PTS1 (permissive) present in: {D.PTS1_perm.sum()}/{len(D)}  -> only AMD2 itself")
print(f"PTS2 present in: {D.PTS2.sum()}/{len(D)}; TM segments present in: {(D.nTM>0).sum()}/{len(D)}")

# ---- PTS1 dodecamer context: hydrophobicity / aromaticity of positions -4..-12 ----
def dodec(s): return s[-12:]
ctrl = {"MDH3":"P32419","SPS19":"P32573","FOX2":"Q02207","PEX8":"P53248","CIT2":"P08679",
        "TES1":"P41903","MLS1":"P30952","PCS60":"P38137","DAL7":"P21826","STR3":"P38716"}
cr=[]
for g,a in ctrl.items():
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    s="".join(t.splitlines()[1:])
    up=s[-12:-3]
    cr.append(dict(prot=g,cls="peroxisomal PTS1",dodecamer=s[-12:],cterm3=s[-3:],
        upstream9=up, up_gravy=round(np.mean([kd[x] for x in up if x in kd]),2),
        up_aromatic=sum(x in "FWY" for x in up), up_basic=sum(x in "KR" for x in up)))
    time.sleep(0.15)
up=AMD2[-12:-3]
cr.insert(0,dict(prot="AMD2",cls="query",dodecamer=AMD2[-12:],cterm3="SKI",upstream9=up,
    up_gravy=round(np.mean([kd[x] for x in up]),2), up_aromatic=sum(x in "FWY" for x in up),
    up_basic=sum(x in "KR" for x in up)))
C=pd.DataFrame(cr)
print("\n=== PTS1 dodecamer context (positions -12..-1); upstream9 = positions -12..-4 ===")
print(C.to_string(index=False))
C.to_csv("pts1_dodecamer_context.csv",index=False)
pg=C[C.cls=="peroxisomal PTS1"]
print(f"\nupstream-9 GRAVY: AMD2 = {C.loc[0,'up_gravy']}, peroxisomal controls mean = {pg.up_gravy.mean():.2f} "
      f"(range {pg.up_gravy.min()} to {pg.up_gravy.max()})")
print(f"upstream-9 aromatic residues: AMD2 = {C.loc[0,'up_aromatic']}, controls mean = {pg.up_aromatic.mean():.1f}")
print(f"upstream-9 basic residues: AMD2 = {C.loc[0,'up_basic']}, controls mean = {pg.up_basic.mean():.1f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
lbl=list(C.prot); vals=list(C.up_gravy)
cols=["#d1495b"]+["#2a7fbf"]*(len(C)-1)
ax[0].bar(lbl,vals,color=cols); ax[0].axhline(0,c="k",lw=.8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("GRAVY of positions -12 to -4"); ax[0].tick_params(axis="x",rotation=45)
ax[0].set_title("Hydrophobicity of the PTS1 dodecamer context\nAMD2 (red) is the only hydrophobic one")
sp=D.species.str.replace(" ","\n"); ax[1].barh(range(len(D))[::-1], D.norm_SW[::-1],
   color=["#d1495b" if a=="P22580" else "#9a9a9a" for a in D.acc][::-1])
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(D))[::-1]); ax[1].set_yticklabels([f"{s.split()[0][:12]}  {t}" for s,t in zip(D.species,D.cterm3)],fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xlabel("Smith-Waterman score vs AMD2, normalised to AMD2 self-score")
ax[1].set_title("Closest amidase-signature homolog per fungal lineage\n(label shows its C-terminal tripeptide)")
for a in ax: [a.spines[s].set_visible(False) for s in ("top","right")]
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
